title: Fine-tuning vs. prompting: when to use which approach
body:
Prompting changes a model's behavior temporarily, for a single request. Fine-tuning actually retrains the model on a custom dataset, permanently adjusting its internal parameters so new behavior becomes built-in.

General guidance: start with prompting (and prompt chaining, system prompts, few-shot examples) — it solves the vast majority of real needs. Only consider fine-tuning when you have a large, well-defined, repetitive task, real data to train on, and prompting alone consistently falls short.
